description: Repo capability matrix (Issue #531): what this specific repository/token can actually enable, beyond GitHub-plan probing already performed by .csarc/scripts/apply-repository-settings.sh. .csarc/scripts/check-repo-capabilities evaluates this matrix against live facts and .csarc/scripts/repo_capabilities.py implements the pure evaluation logic. Every non-'allowed' status below has a workaround documented in the 'workaround' field; several reuse the existing DEGRADED marker apply-repository-settings.sh already prints.

behavior.en: Prerequisite for every other capability below: applying .csarc/policies/*.json, enabling a Ruleset, security scanning, GitHub Pages, Actions permissions, and the issue creation policy all require the acting token to hold Admin on this specific repository.
behavior.zh-tw: 以下每一項能力的前提：套用 .csarc/policies/*.json、啟用 Ruleset、安全掃描、GitHub Pages、Actions 權限與 issue 建立政策，都需要目前使用的 token 對這個 repository 具備 Admin 權限。

requirement.en: `permissions.admin == true` on `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}` for the acting account or token.
requirement.zh-tw: 目前帳號或 token 在 `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}` 回傳的 `permissions.admin` 必須是 `true`。

detection.en: Read-only: the same `permissions.admin` field `.csarc/scripts/apply-repository-settings.sh` already requires before `apply`/`plan`.
detection.zh-tw: 唯讀偵測：與 `.csarc/scripts/apply-repository-settings.sh` 在 `apply`／`plan` 前既有要求相同的 `permissions.admin` 欄位。

workaround.en: Without Admin, only `apply-repository-settings.sh check` (read-only) can run; ask the repository owner or an organization admin to run `plan`/`apply`, or request the Admin role for the acting account.
workaround.zh-tw: 沒有 Admin 時只能執行 `apply-repository-settings.sh check`（唯讀）；請 repository owner 或 organization admin 執行 `plan`／`apply`，或為目前帳號申請 Admin 角色。

title.zh-tw: 透過 GitHub Ruleset 的分支保護

behavior.en: Enforces non-fast-forward pushes, required pull request review, and required status checks on the default branch (`.csarc/policies/rulesets.json`).
behavior.zh-tw: 在預設分支上強制 non-fast-forward push、必要的 PR review 與必要的 status check（`.csarc/policies/rulesets.json`）。

requirement.en: Public repository on any GitHub plan; or a private repository on GitHub Pro (personal account) / GitHub Team or above (organization).
requirement.zh-tw: public repository 在任何 GitHub 方案皆可；private repository 需要 GitHub Pro（個人帳號）或 GitHub Team 以上（organization）。

detection.en: Live probe: `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets`; a 403 with "Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public" confirms the plan limitation.
detection.zh-tw: 即時探測：`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets`；回傳 403 且訊息含 "Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public" 即確認為方案限制。

workaround.en: Existing DEGRADED marker: `apply-repository-settings.sh check`/`plan` prints "DEGRADED required governance" and keeps the desired Ruleset declarative in `.csarc/policies/rulesets.json`; an admin may stage a disabled Ruleset manually in the web UI (`https://github.com/{repo}/settings/rules`) for later enforcement, or upgrade the plan, or make the repository public.
workaround.zh-tw: 既有 DEGRADED 標記：`apply-repository-settings.sh check`／`plan` 會印出「DEGRADED required governance」，並讓 `.csarc/policies/rulesets.json` 保留為 desired state；admin 可在 GitHub 網頁（`https://github.com/{repo}/settings/rules`）手動預先建立一個停用的 Ruleset 供之後啟用，或升級方案，或改為 public。

behavior.en: The Ruleset's `require_code_owner_review` only actually blocks merge when the `.github/CODEOWNERS` team (`@org/team`) exists and has write-or-above access, and this repository can inspect that team's permission.
behavior.zh-tw: Ruleset 的 `require_code_owner_review` 只有在 `.github/CODEOWNERS` 指定的 team（`@org/team`）確實存在且具備 write 以上權限，且這個 repository 能查驗該權限時，才會真正擋下合併。

requirement.en: Depends on `ruleset_enforcement`; additionally the CODEOWNERS team must exist with write-or-above access, readable via `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/teams` (needs organization read, effectively an admin-scope token).
requirement.zh-tw: 依賴 `ruleset_enforcement`；此外 CODEOWNERS 指定的 team 必須存在且具備 write 以上權限，並可透過 `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/teams` 讀取（需要 organization read，實務上即 admin 等級的 token）。

detection.en: Live probe: parse `.github/CODEOWNERS`'s configured `@org/team`, then look it up in `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/teams` and check its `permission`.
detection.zh-tw: 即時探測：解析 `.github/CODEOWNERS` 設定的 `@org/team`，於 `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/teams` 查找並檢查其 `permission`。

workaround.en: Existing DEGRADED marker: "DEGRADED CODEOWNERS inspection" when the token cannot validate owners at all; when the team is genuinely missing or not writable, create or fix `@org/team`'s repository access, or fall back to manually assigning a reviewer with `.csarc/scripts/request-reviewer` until the team is in place.
workaround.zh-tw: 既有 DEGRADED 標記：token 完全無法驗證 owners 時印出「DEGRADED CODEOWNERS inspection」；若 team 確實不存在或權限不足，建立或修正 `@org/team` 的 repository 存取權，或在 team 到位前改用 `.csarc/scripts/request-reviewer` 手動指派 reviewer。

title.zh-tw: Actions 驅動的 PR 自動核准

behavior.en: Lets a repository's Actions workflows (its `GITHUB_TOKEN`) approve pull requests automatically -- used by automated flows such as Dependabot auto-merge.
behavior.zh-tw: 讓 repository 的 Actions workflow（其 `GITHUB_TOKEN`）能自動核准 PR，供 Dependabot auto-merge 等自動化流程使用。

requirement.en: Repository (or organization) Actions settings must allow `can_approve_pull_request_reviews`; some organizations disable this by policy and it cannot be enabled from this repository alone.
requirement.zh-tw: repository（或 organization）Actions 設定必須允許 `can_approve_pull_request_reviews`；部分 organization 以政策禁止此項，單一 repository 無法自行開啟。

detection.en: Live probe: `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/permissions/workflow`. A `true` value confirms the capability is currently active; `false` only shows the current toggle, not whether an organization policy would block turning it on -- only an actual `apply` attempt (caught by `apply-repository-settings.sh`) proves that.
detection.zh-tw: 即時探測：`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/permissions/workflow`。回傳 `true` 可確認目前確實可用；`false` 只反映目前的開關狀態，無法判斷是否有 organization 政策擋下開啟——只有實際嘗試 `apply`（由 `apply-repository-settings.sh` 捕捉）才能證實。

workaround.en: Existing DEGRADED marker: "DEGRADED Actions PR policy" when an `apply` attempt is rejected. Downgrade to manual human approval for automated pull requests, or ask an organization owner to allow Actions to approve PRs; the documented alpha self-approval Ruleset bypass (`.csarc/policies/rulesets.json` `bypass_actors`, see `.csarc/docs/ci-policy.md`) is a separate, narrower mechanism and not a substitute for this capability.
workaround.zh-tw: 既有 DEGRADED 標記：`apply` 嘗試被拒絕時印出「DEGRADED Actions PR policy」。降級為人工核准自動化 PR，或請 organization owner 允許 Actions 核准 PR；既有的 alpha 自我核准 Ruleset bypass（`.csarc/policies/rulesets.json` 的 `bypass_actors`，見 `.csarc/docs/ci-policy.md`）是另一套範圍更窄的機制，不能取代這項能力。

title.en: Advanced security scanning (secret scanning, push protection, Dependabot security updates)
title.zh-tw: 進階安全掃描（secret scanning、push protection、Dependabot security updates）

behavior.en: Enables GitHub-hosted secret scanning, push protection, and Dependabot security updates (`.csarc/policies/security-scanning.json`).
behavior.zh-tw: 啟用 GitHub 代管的 secret scanning、push protection 與 Dependabot security updates（`.csarc/policies/security-scanning.json`）。

requirement.en: Free on every plan for a public repository; a private repository requires a GitHub Advanced Security entitlement (Enterprise, or a purchased GHAS add-on).
requirement.zh-tw: public repository 在任何方案皆免費；private repository 需要 GitHub Advanced Security 授權（Enterprise，或額外購買 GHAS）。

detection.en: Live probe: `security_and_analysis.*.status` on `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}`, compared against `.csarc/policies/security-scanning.json`; observed "disabled" on a private repository is treated as the plan limitation, matching `apply-repository-settings.sh check`'s existing rule.
detection.zh-tw: 即時探測：`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}` 的 `security_and_analysis.*.status`，對照 `.csarc/policies/security-scanning.json`；private repository 觀察到 disabled 時視為方案限制，與 `apply-repository-settings.sh check` 既有規則一致。

workaround.en: Existing DEGRADED marker: "DEGRADED security_and_analysis". Rely on local scanning (`.csarc/scripts/scan-secrets`, gitleaks) instead of hosted secret scanning; consider making the repository public or purchasing GitHub Advanced Security.
workaround.zh-tw: 既有 DEGRADED 標記：「DEGRADED security_and_analysis」。改用本機掃描（`.csarc/scripts/scan-secrets`、gitleaks）取代 hosted secret scanning；可考慮改為 public 或購買 GitHub Advanced Security。

title.en: Hosted GitHub Pages for the repo site
title.zh-tw: repo-site 的 GitHub Pages 代管

behavior.zh-tw: 把 `docs/index.html`／`docs/index.en.html` 發布成 hosted 網站（`.csarc/policies/pages.json`）。

requirement.en: Free on every plan for a public repository; a private repository requires GitHub Enterprise Cloud.
requirement.zh-tw: public repository 在任何方案皆免費；private repository 需要 GitHub Enterprise Cloud。

detection.en: Deterministic from already-observed `repo_visibility` and account `plan_label`; no extra live call is required beyond the repository/account lookups every other row also uses.
detection.zh-tw: 由已取得的 `repo_visibility` 與帳號 `plan_label` 直接判定；不需要額外的即時呼叫，沿用其他列已使用的 repository／帳號查詢即可。

workaround.en: Existing DEGRADED marker: "DEGRADED GitHub Pages". Keep distributing `docs/index.html` as a committed, downloadable file instead of a hosted URL, or make the repository public, or upgrade to GitHub Enterprise Cloud.
workaround.zh-tw: 既有 DEGRADED 標記：「DEGRADED GitHub Pages」。改以 commit 進 repo 的 `docs/index.html` 檔案分享，而非 hosted 網址；或改為 public，或升級到 GitHub Enterprise Cloud。

title.zh-tw: 管理員專屬 repository 欄位可見性

behavior.en: Lets `apply-repository-settings.sh check` compare live administrator-only repository fields (from `.csarc/policies/repository.json`) against desired policy, instead of skipping them.
behavior.zh-tw: 讓 `apply-repository-settings.sh check` 能比對即時的管理員專屬 repository 欄位（來自 `.csarc/policies/repository.json`）與 desired policy，而不是略過不查。

requirement.en: Same as `repository_admin`: a non-admin token (for example the default `GITHUB_TOKEN` in a hosted workflow) cannot read these fields at all.
requirement.zh-tw: 與 `repository_admin` 相同：非 admin 的 token（例如 hosted workflow 預設的 `GITHUB_TOKEN`）完全無法讀取這些欄位。

detection.en: Derived directly from the `repository_admin` fact; no separate live probe.
detection.zh-tw: 直接沿用 `repository_admin` 的偵測結果，不另外探測。

workaround.en: Existing DEGRADED marker: "DEGRADED repository inspection". Run `apply-repository-settings.sh check` from a trusted local checkout authenticated as an admin instead of relying on a hosted workflow's default token.
workaround.zh-tw: 既有 DEGRADED 標記：「DEGRADED repository inspection」。改在具備 admin 身分的可信本機環境執行 `apply-repository-settings.sh check`，而非仰賴 hosted workflow 的預設 token。

title.en: Immutable Releases (repository setting; no longer pre-flight-probed)
title.zh-tw: Immutable Releases（repository 設定；不再 pre-flight 探測）

behavior.en: Repository setting GitHub uses to sign a release attestation for each published GitHub Release. `release.yml`'s Automatic/Guided modes no longer probe or block on this before starting (Issue #770); `.csarc/scripts/publish-release` instead proves it post-hoc, after each publish, by verifying that signed attestation.
behavior.zh-tw: GitHub 用來為每個已發布 GitHub Release 簽發 release attestation 的 repository 設定。`release.yml` 的 Automatic／Guided 模式不再於開始前 pre-flight 探測或卡在這一項（Issue #770）；`.csarc/scripts/publish-release` 改在每次發布後，以驗證這份簽發的 attestation 來 post-hoc 自證。

requirement.en: A repository admin enables the setting once via `.csarc/scripts/apply-repository-settings.sh apply`; the default hosted `GITHUB_TOKEN` still cannot read or prove this admin-scope setting directly -- a structural GitHub Actions limitation (Issue #123/#626) -- which is why detection below stays `unknown`.
requirement.zh-tw: 由 repository admin 透過 `.csarc/scripts/apply-repository-settings.sh apply` 開啟一次；hosted 預設的 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 仍然無法直接讀取或證明這個 admin 範疇的設定——這是 GitHub Actions 結構性的限制（Issue #123／#626），也是下面偵測結果維持 `unknown` 的原因。

detection.en: Not reliably detectable from a repository-permission probe; `.csarc/scripts/check-repo-capabilities` always reports this row as `unknown` with a fixed explanatory note instead of guessing.
detection.zh-tw: 無法單靠 repository 權限探測可靠判斷；`.csarc/scripts/check-repo-capabilities` 對這一列一律回報 `unknown`，並附固定說明，而非用猜測代替。

workaround.en: Post-hoc, not pre-flight: `.csarc/scripts/publish-release`'s `publish`/`rerun-verify` verify GitHub's signed release attestation (`gh release verify --format json`, reused via `.csarc/scripts/verify_release_consumption.py`) after each publish and revert a failed Release to draft when still possible (Issue #770). If the setting was never enabled, publication now fails closed at that later step instead of being blocked before it starts; see `.csarc/docs/ci-policy.md`'s "hosted 發版路徑的已知限制" section.
workaround.zh-tw: Post-hoc，不是 pre-flight：`.csarc/scripts/publish-release` 的 `publish`／`rerun-verify` 在每次發布後驗證 GitHub 簽發的 release attestation（`gh release verify --format json`，透過 `.csarc/scripts/verify_release_consumption.py` 重用），仍可能時把失敗的 Release 收回 draft（Issue #770）。若這個設定從未被真的開啟，發布現在會在這個較晚的步驟 fail closed，而不是一開始就被完全擋下；詳見 `.csarc/docs/ci-policy.md`「hosted 發版路徑的已知限制」一節。
